caption: The drawing is on a square piece of cloth with a beige background, bordered by red and white stripes resembling the American flag. In the center is a circular portrait of a man, surrounded by a ring of blue stars. Radiating outward from the center are twelve oval-shaped portraits of different men, each connected to the central image by a straight line. Between these portraits are four large, detailed illustrations of bald eagles, each holding a shield, arrows, and olive branches, facing in different directions. Behind each eagle are intricately drawn American flags with blue fields and red stripes, positioned at angles. In each corner of the cloth is an oval vignette depicting panoramic views of urban or industrial scenes. Additional small oval portraits fill the spaces between the eagles, flags, and corner scenes. All portraits and scenes are rendered in black and white, while the flags are colored red, white, and blue, and the eagles feature shades of brown, yellow, and white. The overall layout is symmetrical along both horizontal and vertical axes.
title: Historical Textile
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
